pages.text: $(italic)Creatures of ancient magic and wild nature. Faefolk channel devastating arcane power at the cost of physical resilience.$()$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Nature's Blessing$() - $(item)+30% Spell Power$() and $(item)+10% mana regen$(). The highest racial magic bonus.$(br2)$(bold)Fae Swiftness$() - $(item)+10% movement speed$().$(br2)$(bold)Slow Fall$() - Gentle drift on the wind. Reduced fall speed and damage.

pages.title: Tradeoffs
pages.text: $(bold)Frail Strikes$() - $(warn)-30% melee damage$(). The fae body is unsuited to brute force.$(br2)$(bold)Fae Fragility$() - $(warn)-15% max HP$().$(br2)$(bold)Ethereal Form$() - $(warn)-50% armor toughness$() while wearing any medium or heavy armor. Full robes (4/4 light pieces) bypass this entirely.$(br2)$(bold)Two paths, two costs:$() wear robes and accept light armor's -20% generic armor, or wear plate and accept the toughness halving. There is no escape.

pages.title: Build Notes
pages.text: $(bold)Archmage$() - best fit. Pure caster, full robes, +30% Spell Power stacks with Arcane Supremacy.$(br2)$(bold)Battlemage$() - $(thing)offmeta but viable$(). The -30% melee malus hurts, but Arcane Cleave converts your spell power to bonus AD. You'll never out-DPS an Orc Battlemage in raw melee, but spell-fueled hits + Mana Shield make you tankier than a pure mage.$(br2)$(bold)Avoid:$() Berserker, Vanguard, Paladin - the melee malus and HP loss make these strictly worse choices.
